description: A hands-first data-leakage workshop for junior ML engineers preparing for model reviews, built for Meta Quest using Meta IWSDK and WebXR.

userStories.title: Deterministic 1-NN Classifier and Group Leakage Simulation
acceptanceCriteria: 1-Nearest Neighbor classifier with squared Euclidean distance across 6 continuous features.
Deterministic data generation across seeds 0-29 matching published research table.
Leaky split produces 100.0% evaluation accuracy; clean disjoint split produces ~47.5% accuracy.
Audit tray (60 unseen groups) maintains ~50% chance baseline under both conditions.
Automated Node.js unit tests pass with 100% assertion coverage.

userStories.title: Hands-First 3D Spatial Specimen Viewer and Connector Ray
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive rotatable 3D canvas displaying 6D feature projection.
Pinch gesture illuminates 3D trajectory connecting test specimen to its training twin.
Training and evaluation trays positioned within seated reach envelope (0.35m - 0.60m).
Keyboard (Arrow keys) and mouse drag support as desktop fallback.

userStories.title: Group Disjointness Repair and Ledger Updates
acceptanceCriteria: Quarantine gesture evicts all 40 matching training twins and replaces them with 40 reserve groups.
Ledger immediately recalculates evaluation accuracy from 100.0% to 47.5%.
Overlap count drops from 40 to 0 while total training size remains strictly 120 items.
Stage transitions are strictly ordered and idempotent.

userStories.title: Sealed Blind Audit Tray and Review Decision Engine
acceptanceCriteria: Audit tray remains completely sealed until player commits to a repair or verdict.
Unsealing audit reveals true generalization score (18/60, 30.0%).
Player chooses between 'Hold Release' and 'Approve Release'.
Session persists state in localStorage and safely rehydrates upon page reload or headset removal.

userStories.title: Control Case for Disjoint Look-Alike Validation
acceptanceCriteria: Case 2 loads a clean model where nearest neighbor has distinct origin group ID.
Confirming split keeps 90.0% accuracy; audit tray validates at 57/60 (95.0%).
Player passes review by choosing 'Approve Release'.
Session cleanly wraps around to Case 1 upon completion.

userStories.title: Meta IWSDK and WebXR Standalone Quest Deployment
acceptanceCriteria: Meta IWSDK package uses @iwsdk/core 1.0.1 and super-three.
Scene implements OneHandGrabbable, RayInteractable, and PokeInteractable components.
Deployment configurations for Vercel and Netlify enforce WebXR Permissions-Policy and COOP/COEP headers.
Touch targets meet 44px minimum and dark mode color scheme is supported.

userStories.title: Spaced Repetition Practice Scheduler via Half-Life Regression
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Settles & Meeder Half-Life Regression model for retention estimation.
Log elapsed time, mistake rates, and inspection duration per concept.
Dynamically calculate memory decay threshold and scheduled review half-life.

userStories.title: Feature Selection Pre-Split Leakage Workshop Module
acceptanceCriteria: Implement second workshop scenario based on scikit-learn feature selection leakage pitfall.
Allow developer to physically toggle between 'Select features before split' vs 'Select features after split'.
Demonstrate false correlation discovery on purely random synthetic noise.
